title: Orbs rise out of the sea for Danny Jones at Indian Rocks Beach

tellings.quote: When I asked it, just like out of the sky, it comes up out of the sea. And suddenly, here it came. Two of them. Wow. and he filmed it.

plain: In 2025 at Indian Rocks Beach in Florida, two glowing orbs are said to have risen up out of the sea when asked to, and were filmed by Danny Jones, who hosts another podcast. Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs appear around him, tells Michels he was the one who asked: "it comes up out of the sea. And suddenly, here it came. Two of them." He tells it as proof the lights answer him on request.
